title: vigna trinervia var. bourneae
intro: Vigna trinervia var. bourneae, commonly known as the Bourne pea, is a plant species within the family Fabaceae. It is a climbing legume native to tropical Africa, recognized for its medicinal properties. The Bourne pea has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving immune function. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
